description:
## [0.0.18](https://github.com/FarhanZafarr-9/InstaPrime/releases/tag/v0.0.18) (2026-11-01)

Updated to HushGram 0.0.18 while retaining InstaPrime's settings UI and branding. Includes **139 patches**, up from 123 in the previous fork release.

All Instagram patch functionality, research, compatibility work, and ongoing upstream maintenance are the work of **SysAdminDoc and the upstream contributors**. InstaPrime's changes focus on settings presentation and branding.

### Settings UI

- Preserved category pages, nested navigation, wallpaper-derived Material colors, animated circular switches, custom dialogs, and InstaPrime branding and clone defaults.
- Added independent info buttons before switches and chevrons in description-less mode, including selectable settings. Rows remain tappable; the info button opens only the description.
- New settings and their parent categories show a dot at the top-left of the icon, plus a subtle highlight. Visiting one subpage does not clear unseen settings in its siblings.
- Added a little more vertical row padding and a slightly taller Enable all row. Checked narrow layouts and double font size for switch clipping.
- Kept upstream's optional descriptions mode, pure-black handling, selection-state fixes, and new hand-drawn app icon.

### Compatibility and installation

- Stock Instagram **453.0.0.57.79** (com.instagram.android).
- Declared builds: arm64-v8a **385914557**, armeabi-v7a **385914556**, x86 **385914558**. No native x86_64 build is declared for this release.
- Android 9 or newer; **Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer**.
- Refresh the InstaPrime source in Morphe and patch a matching stock APK, or import the attached .mpp as a local source. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK.
- For a separate installation, retain the same clone package and signing key when updating. InstaPrime's clone defaults remain InstaPrime / com.instagram.android.prime.

### Validation

**101 focused UI checks passed**, covering Android API 28 and 37, accessibility, actual ListView touch events, choice dialogs, nested new-setting tracking, and normal and double font sizes. The final build passed bundle verification for all **139 patches and three non-empty DEX payloads**. Build details are recorded in BUILD-INFO.json. SHA256SUMS.txt covers the bundle, SBOM, and build information.

The inherited full fixture release gate and whole-app device walkthrough were **not run for this fork release**. These focused checks do not claim independent device validation of every inherited patch.

### Credit and maintenance

Original project: https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram
Original creator: https://github.com/SysAdminDoc
Support the original creator: https://ko-fi.com/X8K126YVER

InstaPrime is a personal UI rework. Updates may be delayed; use the original HushGram source if you need upstream updates promptly. Existing licenses and notices are retained.
